acceptance_reference.rule: A1's first run: the prefill mode with the higher clear-margin top-1 against the HF reference is the S2 acceptance reference; both baselines are kept per mode

chunked-32k.description: the served default: chunked prefill through the chunk trace, sampling on, MTP off, 32768 context

forced-32k.description: teacher-forced prefill through the decode traces (--prefill-mode teacher_forced), 32768 context

greedy-nothink.description: eval rows at greedy decoding with thinking off (enable_thinking=false, reasoning_effort=low), max_tokens 512

lanes4-mtp4-32k.description: the served lanes mode: four concurrent greedy requests through the MTP lane chain (--lanes 4 --mtp 4, no sampling; the verify-rows fold off for the process), chunked prefill, 32768 context; the pins read the lanes' startup replay (acceptance-lanes.json)

mtp4-32k.description: chunked prefill with MTP drafting k=4 (--mtp 4), 32768 context

oracle-bf16.description: the tt/ CPU oracle with bf16 experts as the column under test (A2), the HF reference as a

oracle-bf4.description: the tt/ CPU oracle with BF4-rounded experts (the device's expert precision) as the column under test

slab2048-32k.description: the served default with the 2048-row prefill slab (--prefill-slab 2048; the slab's routed experts in one moe_compute call per layer, QWEN38_MOE_SLAB_ONE_CALL and QWEN38_MOE_SLAB_RINGS unset): chunked prefill through the chunk trace for the remainder, sampling on, MTP off, 32768 context

slab2048-mtp4-32k.description: chunked prefill with the 2048-row prefill slab and MTP drafting k=4 (--prefill-slab 2048 --mtp 4: the 128-row MTP chunk extension's slab form runs the slab's MTP rows inside the slab body), 32768 context

thinking-medium.description: eval rows at the shipped request defaults (thinking on, reasoning_effort=medium), greedy, max_tokens 1536

vision-chunked-32k.description: image prompts on the served default chain with the device vision tower's features: chunked prefill through the 32-row chunk trace (the 128-row form is bitwise on these streams), sampling on, MTP off, 32768 context; the fixtures are tests/fixtures/vision_fixture.py's grid32 (512x512, 256 image tokens), grid24x40 (384x640, 240), grid64 (1024x1024, 1024) and models/sample_data/demo.jpeg (2048x1365, 2752), each asked to describe the image in one sentence with thinking off, 32 greedy tokens against the CPU reference (Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration bf16)

D1/chunked-32k/decode_ms_per_token.note: the timing runner's 32-token median after warm-up; 27.77 ms median over 200 traced steps on 4x p150 on 2026-09-25 (dsp-timing-a-tree-f2933ef2-20260925T070237Z; 35.90 on the base 30cc1a5e5d in the same hold, dsp-timing-a-tree-30cc1a5e-20260925T065824Z) with bf8 dense weights, the fused GDN step and moe_compute's compact expert layout on by default; was 35.82 ms median over 200 traced steps on 4x p150 on 2026-09-25 (dsp-timing-a-tree-7c6f7c9f-20260925T003535Z; 36.91 before it in the same hold, -003133Z) with the gated-residual read as two programs with its gathers inside them (gr_fold) on by default; was 36.92 ms on 2026-09-18 with the router tail's top-k on one core per token group (its lane form) on by default; was 38.67 ms on 2026-09-16 with the fused decode kernels (gr_read, gr_write, greedy_tail, moe_post, ple, position_derive, qsa_block, router_tail, shared_expert) and two DRAM readers per bank for the GDN/QSA/LM-head decode linears on by default; was 42.14 ms on 2026-09-15 and 50.00 / 50.01 ms on both lanes on 2026-09-04 (a proposal: seed it)
